London, England  ·  Est. 1976  ·  A Life in Full
BENEDICT
CUMBERBATCH
The cerebral outsider who became the face of a generation's heroes.
Born 19 July 1976 in Hammersmith, London. Son of actors Timothy Carlton and Wanda Ventham. Educated at Harrow School. Trained at Victoria University of Manchester and RADA.
Stage. Screen. Strange dimensions. A career built on patience, precision, and an intelligence that proved — once and for all — that it could be electric.
London  ·  1976
